controllerAcceptedFindings.mechanism: The temporary safety string stripped title URLs, while excerpt/citation rendering retained the raw title. Repair must validate title separately and only remove known renderer-stripped body URLs.
The doctor-phrase mask did not require conditional preparation wording. Require the explicit conditional phrase and retain negative imperative controls.
A broad preceding refusal/khong could excuse a comma-joined medication imperative without a listed contrastive word. Add strict direct-action rejection and preserve ordinary refusal/caution controls.

One service-hours test remains red under hold=true. Controller design: simple authorized operational facts must render deterministically without consulting an injected provider. Assertions must not be weakened.
Same-source lock waiters can exhaust the main pool while the lock holder needs REQUIRES_NEW cleanup/audit connections. The two-caller green test does not settle pool-sized concurrency.
Reminder versioning uses immutable appointment.createdAt; mutable schedule fields are not reflected. Appointment has no updatedAt field, so a suggested getUpdatedAt fix is invalid.
Server-generated document controls are tied to the generic media-upload flag, not a document-specific capability. No security guard may be bypassed to hide this discrepancy.
Putting bytes before committing the cleanup marker leaves a failure window if marker persistence and immediate deletion both fail.
